## History

Prissy Andrews was a fellow student of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. Prior to the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations, she sat up half the night every night of her exam week to cram for the test. Her experiences with the rigorous tests served as a reference point for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as she pursued her own education and successfully passed her exams.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phillips--prissy-andrews.md)

Prissy Andrews is a student taught by the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolmaster, Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md). Their connection goes beyond a typical pupil-teacher dynamic, as Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) is actively courting her. However, their personal relationship can cause friction in the classroom, such as when Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) spends much of his time helping Prissy with her lessons while neglecting the rest of his students.

- Student of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001)</sub>
- Romantically involved with — courting her  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001)</sub>
